This establishes Dorothy as a common ancestor of both Doris and Edward.

- From Denise: Denise \(\to\) Judy \(\to\) Larry \(\to\) Sandra \(\to\) Jose \(\to\) Scott \(\to\) Sara \(\to\) Heather \(\to\) Gary \(\to\) Jennifer \(\to\) Stephen \(\to\) Gerald \(\to\) Douglas \(\to\) Paul \(\to\) Wayne \(\to\) Walter \(\to\) Jerry \(\to\) Olivia \(\to\) Alexis \(\to\) Jessica \(\to\) Megan \(\to\) Benjamin \(\to\) Mary \(\to\) Jeremy \(\to\) Doris.

Since Denise is a descendant of Dorothy, this places Doris as a descendant of Dorothy as well.

No chain exists from Doris to Edward (or vice versa), so neither is an ancestor or descendant of the other. No common descendant is given in the relations. Thus, the only correct relation among the options is that Doris and Edward share a common ancestor.
